Product Recalls

Contoso Home Goods publishes every voluntary recall it issues, together with the hazard identified, the remedy offered and the number of units affected. Notices remain on this page indefinitely and are listed newest first.

If you own an affected product, stop using it and follow the remedy described in the notice. Our support team can arrange replacement parts, refunds or collection.

  1. Notice 2026-014

    Contoso recalls the Halden swivel chair after reports of falls

    Product
    Halden 5-Star Swivel Desk Chair (model HLD-500, black and oak)
    Hazard
    Gas lift cylinder can fracture under load, dropping the seat without warning; fall and impact injuries.
    Date published
    2026-04-18
    Remedy
    Stop using the chair. Contoso will ship a free replacement cylinder with installation hardware, or issue a full refund.
    Units affected
    48,200 units in the United States and 6,100 in Canada

  2. Notice 2026-009

    Contoso recalls Brimfield convertible cribs due to slat separation

    Product
    Brimfield 4-in-1 Convertible Crib (models BRM-C1, BRM-C1W)
    Hazard
    Side slats can loosen and separate, creating a gap in which an infant can become entrapped.
    Date published
    2026-02-27
    Remedy
    Stop using the crib immediately and contact Contoso for a free hardware retrofit kit.
    Units affected
    12,750 units

  3. Notice 2026-003

    Contoso recalls Nordvik electric kettles after burn reports

    Product
    Nordvik 1.7L Stainless Electric Kettle (model NRD-KT17)
    Hazard
    Lid latch can release while pouring, spilling boiling water onto the user.
    Date published
    2026-01-15
    Remedy
    Return the kettle to any Contoso Home Goods store for a full refund or a store credit of equal value.
    Units affected
    31,400 units

  4. Notice 2025-041

    Contoso recalls the Lyndale bunk bed ladder over weld failures

    Product
    Lyndale Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed (model LYN-BB2)
    Hazard
    Ladder rung welds can fail, causing a fall from height.
    Date published
    2025-11-06
    Remedy
    Contoso will send a free replacement ladder assembly. Do not use the upper bunk until the ladder is replaced.
    Units affected
    9,880 units

  5. Notice 2025-037

    Contoso recalls Perrin high chairs due to tray latch defect

    Product
    Perrin Wooden High Chair (models PRN-HC1, PRN-HC1N)
    Hazard
    Tray latch can disengage, allowing a child to fall forward out of the chair.
    Date published
    2025-10-22
    Remedy
    Stop using the high chair. A free remedy kit containing a redesigned latch is available on request.
    Units affected
    22,300 units

  6. Notice 2025-033

    Contoso recalls Ashcombe floor lamps after overheating reports

    Product
    Ashcombe Arc Floor Lamp (model ASH-FL3)
    Hazard
    Internal wiring can overheat at the socket, posing a fire hazard.
    Date published
    2025-09-30
    Remedy
    Unplug the lamp and return it to any Contoso Home Goods store for a full refund.
    Units affected
    15,600 units

  7. Notice 2025-028

    Contoso recalls Marlow dresser units over tip-over hazard

    Product
    Marlow Six-Drawer Dresser (model MRL-D6)
    Hazard
    Dresser is unstable if not anchored to a wall and can tip over onto a child.
    Date published
    2025-08-14
    Remedy
    Contoso will provide a free anti-tip anchoring kit and, on request, free in-home installation.
    Units affected
    54,100 units

  8. Notice 2025-024

    Contoso recalls the Fenwick pressure cooker lid assembly

    Product
    Fenwick 6-Quart Electric Pressure Cooker (model FNW-PC6)
    Hazard
    Lid can be opened while the vessel is still pressurised, expelling hot contents.
    Date published
    2025-07-09
    Remedy
    Stop using the pressure cooker. Contact Contoso for a free replacement lid assembly.
    Units affected
    18,450 units

  9. Notice 2025-019

    Contoso recalls Selby toy chests after lid closure injuries

    Product
    Selby Hinged Toy Chest (model SLB-TC1)
    Hazard
    Lid support can fail and the heavy lid can close on a child head or hands.
    Date published
    2025-06-03
    Remedy
    Contoso will ship a free slow-close hinge retrofit kit at no cost to the consumer.
    Units affected
    7,920 units

  10. Notice 2025-012

    Contoso recalls Weatherby glass carafes over thermal cracking

    Product
    Weatherby 1.2L Borosilicate Carafe (model WTB-CR12)
    Hazard
    Carafe can crack when filled with boiling liquid, causing cuts and scald injuries.
    Date published
    2025-04-21
    Remedy

    26,700 units

  11. Notice 2025-007

    Contoso recalls Idlewood changing tables due to rail collapse

    Product
    Idlewood Changing Table with Storage (model IDL-CT2)
    Hazard
    Safety rail can detach from the frame, allowing an infant to roll off the surface.
    Date published
    2025-03-11
    Remedy

    Units affected
    5,340 units

  12. Notice 2025-002

    Contoso recalls the Ravensmoor space heater over ignition risk

    Product
    Ravensmoor 1500W Ceramic Space Heater (model RVM-SH15)
    Hazard
    Thermal cutoff can fail to engage, allowing the housing to ignite nearby fabric.
    Date published
    2025-01-28
    Remedy
    Unplug the heater immediately. Contoso will issue a full refund or an equivalent replacement model.
    Units affected
    41,050 units
